redistribution_note: The full raw and generated clean-source corpora are large local artifacts. Verify upstream license terms before redistributing a full derived corpus.

local_inputs.format: JSONL rows with conversation_id, category, and conversation entries containing human/assistant fields

intended_tracks: Track B public semantic-sidecar pilot after reviewed sidecar materialization
Track B semantic line-reranker input after source-visible candidate selection
datasets.claim_boundary: Generated clean-source rows are not semantic-sidecar-required samples unless a reviewed semantic-scope-labels.jsonl sidecar is materialized for the sampled registry subset.

reported_source_mix.note: Source-family counts are reported conversion context and are not a replacement for the clean-source dataset row counts above.

benchmark_entrypoints.smoke_sampling_override: --sharegpt-sampling-mode first-n keeps the old first-N smoke/debug behavior and marks the report with a seeded_stratified_population_sampling cannot-claim boundary
--sharegpt-public-sampling-mode first-n keeps the old first-N smoke/debug behavior and marks the report with a seeded_stratified_population_sampling cannot-claim boundary
benchmark_entrypoints.claim_boundary: public-corpus source-evidence retrieval baseline; does not replace private real-history source-evidence quality

benchmark_entrypoints.report_policy: .tmp/ is ignored by default; keep generated subset, sidecar, registry, and live report local unless a future curated subset is deliberately promoted

current_runner_controls.claim_boundary: controls are reported beside the semantic-sidecar track; a wrong-message negative control passing the same quality gate blocks semantic-sidecar quality claims

latest_local_result.selection_method: bounded ShareGPT clean-source subset with source-backed semantic sidecar rows

sample_size_warning.selection_method: bounded ShareGPT clean-source subset with source-backed semantic sidecar rows

benchmark_entrypoints.claim_boundary: public semantic-sidecar diagnostic pilot only; does not claim human-reviewed labels, empirical public semantic-sidecar quality below the minimum case count, unbounded public semantic-sidecar quality, or private real-history source-evidence quality
